title: Ice Cream Arc
summary: Hi everyone! I know I said I would be back soon, but I was busy living :) In fact, I lived my Ice Cream Scooper Arc!! It was incredible!! 🥳
content:
Hi everyone! I know I said I would be back soon, but I was busy living :) In fact, I lived my Ice Cream Scooper Arc!! It was incredible!! 🥳
Let me tell the story... I came to Australia in November to escape winter in my country :) Then I decided to work there... Australia is a land of opportunities, and I found myself creating the most beautiful CV to get hired as... and Ice Cream Scooper / Kitchen Hand!!! ✨✨✨
Guys, you have to know something... I love ice cream! I also love to share happiness!! ^^ And ice cream is happiness!! Needless to say I was thriving at this job!! >v<
It ended a week ago when I decided to go back in my country... I was really sad, but that only shows how much I loved this job! This was also one of my first experience in customer service... I think I am built for this!! 🔥🔥🔥
